title: calesthio/Crucix
claim: Self-hosted “personal intelligence terminal”: one command spins up a dashboard watching 27 OSINT sources — zero cloud, a single dependency — and pings you when something changes.
why_good: 10.9k stars in two months proved the appetite: Bloomberg-terminal-style situational awareness without anyone else's cloud in the loop. The radical simplicity (one express dep, Docker-ready) is the actual feature.
value: The self-hosted monitoring seat for traders, journalists and security teams — paid source packs, alert routing, and a hosted tier for those who won't self-host. Situational-awareness dashboards are classic prosumer subscription territory.
risk: No commits since May 20 with 10.9k stars watching — the maintainer may have already walked away, and an OSINT aggregator lives or dies by source upkeep: when scrapers rot, the product rots with them.

zh.claim: 自托管的“个人情报终端”：一条命令拉起监控 27 个 OSINT 信息源的仪表盘（零云依赖、仅一个依赖包），有变化即时提醒。
zh.why_good: 两个月 1.09 万星证明了需求：人们想要彭博终端式的态势感知，却不想让别人的云插在中间。极简本身就是卖点（仅 express 一个依赖、Docker 即开即用）。
zh.value: 商业价值：面向交易员、记者与安全团队的自托管监控席位 — 付费信息源包、告警路由，以及给不愿自托管者的托管版。态势感知仪表盘是典型的专业消费者订阅生意。
zh.risk: 5 月 20 日后再无提交，1 万星围观下维护者可能已经离场；OSINT 聚合器的命脉是信息源维护 — 爬虫一烂，产品跟着烂。
